rows.paragraph: combinations(range(n), k) 依次给出恰好 k 个不同下标的组合；covered.update 把一个人的技能加入集合。集合相等表示恰好覆盖要求。n 是人数、m 是技能数。最坏有 2ⁿ 个组合，每个要合并至多 n·m 项技能：O(2ⁿ·n·m) 时间，O(n+m) 辅助空间（不保存所有组合）。n=60 时不能逐队尝试。官方上限是 m≤16、n≤60，并不保证每个输入都有 m<n。例如，接下来的贪心陷阱有 6 项技能、3 个人；也允许 1 个人拥有全部 16 项技能。选择按覆盖保存状态，是因为技能数的上限较小：覆盖至多有 2ᵐ≤2¹⁶=65,536 种，而人员子集至多有 2⁶⁰ 个。
rows.input: 所需技能（从右到左的位顺序）：a, b, c, d, e, f
rows.output: 目前全覆盖的最小团队：[1,2]（2 人）。所有人已处理：这是最终最小团队。

rows.paragraph: combinations(range(n), k) yields each choice of k distinct indices; covered.update adds one person’s skills to a set. Set equality means all requirements are covered. With n people and m skills, there can be 2ⁿ teams, each merging up to n·m skill entries: O(2ⁿ·n·m) time and O(n+m) auxiliary space without storing all teams. Trying every team is impractical at n=60. The official bounds are m≤16 and n≤60; this does not guarantee m<n for each input. For example, the greedy trap below has 6 skills and 3 people; one person with all 16 skills is also valid. We store states by coverage because the skill-count bound is smaller: at most 2ᵐ≤2¹⁶=65,536 coverages, versus up to 2⁶⁰ person subsets.
rows.input: Required skills (bits from right to left): a, b, c, d, e, f
rows.output: Smallest full-coverage team so far: [1,2] (2 people). All people processed: this is a final minimum team.
